title: Vision-language foundation models: alignment, grounding, and composition
status: complete; recorded editorial and validation gates passed
transcript_provenance: Local machine transcription; not publisher captions
source_uncertainties: ASR names SimCLR, CLIP, CoCa, LLaVA, Flamingo, Molmo, SAM and VisProg inconsistently; corrected against official slides and primary papers.
Zero-shot means no target-task labels used for adaptation, not absence of related pretraining data.
Pointing and chaining are described as auditable interfaces rather than guarantees against hallucination.
Minimum-loss mask selection is separated from ground-truth-free deployment selection.
